description: This script sets up and tests the functionality of git pack-objects with large deltas, involving creating pack files, computing object IDs, and performing repacks with large deltas.

methods.name: test_oid
methods.description: Computes the object ID for a given packlib object.

methods.name: clear_packs
methods.description: Clears existing pack files to prepare for new packing.

methods.name: pack_header
methods.description: Creates a pack header with specified number of objects.

methods.name: pack_obj
methods.description: Packs a specific object given its object ID.

methods.name: pack_trailer
methods.description: Generates a pack trailer for the created pack file.
